video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Wanderlust Journals / history): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must be descriptive and wistful. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice — dreamy, with ambient street sounds or nature. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual — a scenic street or landscape. Character: traveler (backpack, camera). Lighting: natural sunlight. Maintain same location vibe and light. Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers.
